description:
Lists up to 25 real MCP servers matching a need, each with connection info and measured reliability, in relevance order.
Use when: you want to compare several options yourself.
Do not use when: you just want the best answer (use solve_need).
Example: {"need":"weather forecast","limit":10,"remote_only":true}

limit.description: How many options to return (1-25, default 8)

remote_only.description: true = only tools callable over HTTPS, nothing to install

name: find_capability
title: Browse matching tools (list)
